name: Property – Real Estate Directory Listing
author: themeglow

sections.description:
Property – Real Estate Directory Listing is the ultimate WordPress plugin for managing property listings, real estate directories, and classified ads. Whether you’re building a business directory, a real estate marketplace, or a local classifieds site, this plugin offers all the essential tools for a seamless experience.

🚀 Why Choose Property – Real Estate Directory Listing?
– SEO Optimized: Structured data, schema markup, and fast performance enhance search engine rankings.
– Mobile-Friendly & Responsive: Works perfectly on all devices.
– Customizable & Flexible: Add custom fields, categories, and filters effortlessly.
– Easy Monetization: Charge users for premium listings with WooCommerce integration.
– Fast & Lightweight: Optimized code ensures high performance.

🎯 Key Features:
✔ Advanced Search & Filters – Helps users find properties quickly.
✔ Frontend Submission – Users can submit and manage listings directly from the frontend.
✔ Google Maps & OpenStreetMap Integration – Display property locations dynamically.
✔ CSV Import & Export – Easily bulk upload or download listings.
✔ Ratings & Reviews – Allow users to review and rate properties.
✔ Shortcodes & Widgets – Display listings anywhere on your site.
✔ Multilingual Ready – Fully compatible with WPML, Loco Translate, and Polylang.
✔ Custom Fields & Taxonomies – Adapt the plugin to your needs.
✔ WooCommerce Payment Integration – Charge for premium listings.
✔ Image Gallery & Video Support – Showcase listings with high-quality images and videos.
✔ AJAX-powered Listings – Fast, dynamic updates without page reloads.

🔗 Live Demo | Documentation | Support

External Services

This plugin integrates with third-party services to provide enhanced functionality:

  • Google Maps API – Displays interactive maps. Privacy Policy
  • OpenStreetMap API – Free alternative to Google Maps. Privacy Policy
  • LocationIQ API – Geolocation and address lookup. Privacy Policy
  • YouTube & Vimeo – Embed property listing videos. YouTube | Vimeo
  • Fancybox & Colorbox – Lightbox image effects.

Support & Feedback

Need help? Visit our Support Page or explore our Documentation.

We appreciate your feedback! If you enjoy using this plugin, please leave us a review on WordPress.org. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sections.installation:
1. Download and upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure settings via the plugin options panel.
  4. Use provided shortcodes or widgets to display property listings.
sections.faq:
Q: Is this plugin compatible with Elementor and page builders?

A: Yes! It works seamlessly with Elementor, WPBakery, Divi, and other page builders.

Q: Can I charge users for listing submissions?

A: Yes, WooCommerce integration allows you to create paid listing plans.

Q: Does it support multiple locations and currencies?

A: Yes, the plugin allows multiple location selection and custom currency settings.

Q: Can I restrict listings to logged-in users only?

A: Yes, access control settings allow you to restrict listing submissions and views.

Q: Does this plugin support OpenStreetMap as an alternative to Google Maps?

A: Yes, OpenStreetMap is fully supported as a free mapping alternative.
